verdict.rationale: Asking questions about workspace content is a fair axis for a work-management SaaS, but the evidence shows no native AI Q&A feature that answers from boards and cards with citations. The documented AI feature only helps write or edit content, which is an adjacent capability. The MCP server, which lets external AI tools connect to Trello, and the Search API are developer building blocks rather than an in-product cited-answer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
